component.name: Rewamp
component.summary: Chiptune, tracker and console music player

description.p: Rewamp plays the music of the machines that made it. Not recordings — emulation. A .sid runs on an emulated 6581, a .nsf on the NES sound hardware, a .mod through a real Amiga Paula mixer. What you hear is the chip doing the work, exactly as it did on the original hardware.
More than 35 audio engines cover over 1,200 file extensions:

ul.li: Tracker modules — MOD, XM, S3M, IT, MPTM, and dozens of older Amiga and PC formats
Amiga — 300+ custom-player formats through a full 68k emulator (TFMX, Hippel, Future Composer, David Whittaker…)
Commodore 64 — SID, with HVSC song lengths and STIL credits
Nintendo — NSF, GBS, SPC, GSF, 2SF, NCSF, SNSF, USF
Sega, NEC, SNK — VGM, S98, HES, SGC, SSF, DSF
Computers — MSX, ZX Spectrum, Atari ST and 8-bit, Amstrad CPC, PC-98, X68000, FM Towns, AdLib OPL2/OPL3
Game streams — 700+ container formats via vgmstream
Also MIDI with SoundFonts, SunVox, PxTone, Organya and Furnace
Oscilloscope — stereo, or one trace per voice with the real channel names
Spectrum — five looks, from classic bars to a full-screen beam and a polar ring
Notation — every note as it plays, with vibrato, pan and zoom
Pattern — the tracker view, in the original font, with VU meters per channel
Milkdrop — the full projectM engine and its preset library

description.p: Mute any voice, isolate a single channel, and hear how the track was built. Search a large online archive of chip and tracker music by title, artist, group, platform or format; browse by demoparty, production or year. Downloads live in your library and play without a connection.
An account is optional and never required. With one, your library, playlists and favourites follow you to your other devices.
